witness_description: No certified counterexample: every candidate remains undecidable from the supplied quote.
refutation_explanation: The quote does not define the domain of n, whether “factors” includes n+1 itself or only proper factors, what the “previous n numbers” are, or the index set and permitted values of the n_i in the product. Testing any interpretation would therefore invent missing mathematical data.
search_space: All 256 integer candidates n in the fixed bounded set {1, 2, ..., 256} were visited in increasing order; all 256 were classified as undecidable because the supplied claim lacks the definitions needed for an exact counterexample predicate.
